title: Reopening a closed published task in the main checkout is silently dropped
body: The reopen writes bytes equal to an earlier open blob; stillPending treats any blob seen in origin base history as published and drops it, so the task stays closed though edit exits 0 (src/task/pending.ts:101-138, src/task/store.ts:527).

Evidence: an external Gemini audit (2026-11-20) wrote the reproduction .krn/runs/gemini-audit/d7-*.test.ts; it fails by assertion on main 1856e2d, and an independent krn-reader pass confirmed the premise and the expected behaviour against the source.
Outcome: the reproduction becomes the regression test at the lowest layer that shows the defect (KRN-14) and passes; the fix names the defect class in Root cause and Redesign lines (KRN-15).

Files: src/task/pending.ts, src/task/store.ts, test/task/pending-records.test.ts
Proof: node --test .krn/runs/gemini-audit/d7-task-reopen-vanishes.test.ts fails by assertion on the base and passes after the fix
